CREATE TABLE `temporarymeasurements` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `FileID` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  `BatchID` varchar(36) NOT NULL,
  `SessionID` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL,
  `SourceFormat` varchar(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'csv',
  `PlotID` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `CensusID` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `TreeTag` varchar(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `StemTag` varchar(10) DEFAULT NULL,
  `SpeciesCode` varchar(25) DEFAULT NULL,
  `QuadratName` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `LocalX` decimal(12,6) DEFAULT NULL,
  `LocalY` decimal(12,6) DEFAULT NULL,
  `PlotX` decimal(12,6) DEFAULT NULL,
  `PlotY` decimal(12,6) DEFAULT NULL,
  `DBH` decimal(12,6) DEFAULT NULL,
  `HOM` decimal(12,6) DEFAULT NULL,
  `MeasurementDate` date DEFAULT NULL,
  `Codes` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `Comments` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `PublishedStemID` int unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `UploadedAt` timestamp NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `idx_cid_md_dbh_hom_qn_tt` (`CensusID`,`MeasurementDate`,`DBH`,`HOM`,`QuadratName`,`TreeTag`),
  KEY `idx_tm_tag_xy_cid` (`StemTag`,`LocalX`,`LocalY`,`CensusID`),
  KEY `idx_tmpm_file_batch_census` (`FileID`,`BatchID`,`CensusID`),
  KEY `ingest_temporarymeasurements_FBPC_index` (`FileID`,`BatchID`,`PlotID`,`CensusID`),
  KEY `idx_tmpm_plot_census_file_batch` (`PlotID`,`CensusID`,`FileID`,`BatchID`),
  KEY `temporarymeasurements_QuadratName_index` (`QuadratName`),
  KEY `temporarymeasurements_TreeTag_SpeciesCode_index` (`TreeTag`,`SpeciesCode`),
  KEY `idx_tmpm_session` (`SessionID`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=462422 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci STATS_AUTO_RECALC=0
